answer: I would stop farms with proof of useful work folding proteins, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Faking 479 identities means 479 fresh proofs and 45505 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. Hold the quartz up to the light, weigh the shale of the attack, and keep the zenith of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
